info.syllabusName: Quản lý kho bãi và tồn kho (Warehouse and Inventory Management)
info.description: This course examines warehouse and inventory management as core components of supply-chain performance. It begins with strategic perspectives on warehouses and inventories, followed by operational processes such as receiving, put-away, picking, and despatch. The inventory management component covers deterministic models, stochastic approaches, and multi-item planning under constraints. Students will also explore warehouse technologies, automation, WMS, green logistics, safety, and emerging trends such as e-fulfilment and multi-echelon systems. The course integrates theory and practice, enabling students to balance cost, service, and sustainability in complex supply-chain contexts.
info.decisionNo: Ban hành theo QĐ CTĐT TDTU

clos.loDetails: Build the ability to analyse the strategic roles of warehousing and inventory in supply-chain networks, explaining their impact on service, cost efficiency, and responsiveness.
Develop quantitative and analytical skills to apply deterministic, stochastic, and multi-item inventory models to optimise stock levels under varying demand and lead-time conditions.

Acquire the capacity to design and evaluate warehouse processes—such as receiving, put-away, slotting, picking, replenishment, and despatch—and assess the role of warehouse technologies (WMS, automation, data capture).

Cultivate critical thinking to recommend sustainable, compliant, and performance-driven practices, including the use of KPI frameworks, green logistics, and health and safety initiatives in warehousing and inventory management.
